text: The council says we need a bat survey before they'll validate our loft conversion. It's a 1930s semi in OX4 with a clay tile roof. We want to start building in March next year.
hi, planning officer asked for a bat survey for a barn conversion, old stone barn with a slate roof, near Hereford HR2. no deadline yet but asap please

We're demolishing a bungalow (built 1960s, concrete tiles) and building two houses on the plot in Wealden. The pre-app advice said we'd need ecology surveys. Not sure which ones. Site is about 0.15 hectares with a pond next door.

Extension to the back of a terraced house in London SE15. Council validation team says we need a flood risk assessment because we're in flood zone 2. Application already submitted, reference 26/AP/1234.
Converting a pub's upstairs into two flats, Bath. The building is listed. We've been told to submit a heritage statement. The pub kitchen is staying open downstairs.
New dormer roof, house is a Victorian semi with slate roof in Leicester LE2. No idea what survey we need, the council just said 'ecology'. Need the report by 1 June.
Building a single house on a field in Cornwall. Council asked for a preliminary ecological appraisal and a drainage strategy because there's no mains sewer, we'll use a treatment plant.
Large oak tree with a TPO next to where we want to build a garage. Council wants a tree survey. Postcode NE46.
Opening a takeaway in an empty shop on a high street in Leicester. They want details of the extraction and a noise report for the fans because there are flats above.
we got a letter saying our application is invalid, need bat survey. house is old. please help
Replacing the roof of a 1900s farmhouse in North Yorkshire. Previous survey in 2023 found bats in the roof void. Council says we need updated surveys this summer. Deadline end of August.
Developer here: 12 homes on a 1.2 hectare greenfield site near Ipswich, IP12. Need PEA, BNG assessment, and great crested newt eDNA for 3 ponds within 250m. Programme wants reports by May.
Small loft conversion. Budget is tight, I can't spend more than £300 on a survey. Is that possible? Postcode BS3.
Council said our site in Barnsley is in a coal mining high risk area so we need a coal mining risk assessment for a new bungalow.
Converting a Methodist chapel into a house in Wales. Need a bat survey and a structural survey. The chapel has been empty for ten years.
We're building flats close to the neighbours in Southwark and the planner wants a daylight and sunlight assessment. 6 storeys.
Our extension is near the coast in Suffolk and the council mentioned a coastal erosion assessment. House is about 80 metres from the cliff edge.
I don't know what I need. I want to knock through and build a two storey side extension on my 1950s house in Cheshire. Roof is concrete tiles. Do I need a survey?
Need someone this week!! Bat survey for loft, council deadline is in 10 days, postcode M20 4. Will pay extra for speed.
Retrospective application for a garden room in Brighton BN1 that we already built. Council asked for nothing so far but my neighbour complained about noise from the heat pump.
